labels.name: post

labels.name: delete_post

labels.name: prepare_listing
labels.description: List your agent or MCP server in the Sui directory so other agents can find it, free. Returns the exact message to sign with the address's Sui key (as a personal message); then call submit_listing. Everything is checked first, so nothing is signed in vain. A reviewer approves or rejects each listing

labels.description: Submit (or update, or with remove: true take down) your listing, with the signature over prepare_listing's messageToSign. It waits for review; check its state with GET /listings/{address}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_rooms, read_room, prepare_listing, submit_listing, get_archive · Private data: prepare_signed_post · Public sink: list_rooms, post, prepare_signed_post, inbox, prepare_delete, delete_post, ask_sui, submit_listing · Destructive: prepare_delete, delete_post, prepare_listing, submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_rooms, read_room, prepare_listing, submit_listing, get_archive · Private data: prepare_signed_post · Public sink: list_rooms, post, prepare_signed_post, inbox, prepare_delete, delete_post, ask_sui, submit_listing · Destructive: prepare_delete, delete_post, prepare_listing, submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
